summary: Old Chiangmai Cultural Center in Hai Ya pairs a communal Northern Thai khantoke meal with Lanna music and dance. It is a hosted, theatrical introduction to regional food and performance: convenient for a first visit, though more polished for visitors than an everyday local dinner.
whyGo: A single evening combines shared dishes with a scheduled Lanna performance, giving useful cultural context without organizing separate activities.
The venue describes its khantoke dinner as a long-running Chiang Mai institution, operating since around 1970–71.
bestFor: First-time visitors, families and groups who enjoy dinner shows and a set schedule.
People wanting to sample several Northern Thai dishes together rather than order a single plate.
skipIf: You want a quiet, independent restaurant meal or an in-depth performance with cultural interpretation.
Low-table or floor seating could be difficult; ask about chair seating and access before reserving.
duration: Allow about 2 hours. The venue lists dinner and showtime as 18:30–20:30; arrive at the time on your reservation.
cost: A current booking listing shows tickets from ฿690, while package options and dietary menus may cost more or less. Treat this as a reference only and confirm the December 2026 price, inclusions and transfer costs directly.
hours: The venue currently advertises dinner and showtime 18:30–20:30, Tuesday–Sunday evenings. This is a published regular schedule, not confirmation that every date in December 2026 will run; verify your date.
bestTime: Choose an evening when you want a meal and performance together. Reserve ahead for December and confirm the start time; Saturday evenings can be slower to reach because Wua Lai Road hosts its walking street.
gettingThere: At 185/3 Wua Lai Road, Hai Ya, Chiang Mai 50100. A taxi or ride-hailing car from the old city is the simplest option; allow extra time on Saturday and agree a return pickup point. The venue also lists parking.
booking: Reserve through the venue’s official website or contact +66 95 145 0296 / reservation@oldchiangmai.com. Confirm date, menu, seating, price and any transport inclusion. The official cancellation page says a full deposit refund requires at least 3 days’ notice; late cancellations may receive only 50%, and same-day cancellations may receive none.
accessibility: The venue does not clearly document step-free access, accessible toilets or seating choices on the pages checked. Khantoke dining is traditionally low-table and may involve floor seating; contact the venue before paying to request chairs and discuss mobility, hearing or dietary needs.
practicalTips: The venue describes a shared set of nine dishes, including Hang Ley curry, chili dips, sticky rice and vegetables; ask about current menu and allergen substitutions.
Request vegetarian, halal or other dietary menus when booking, and confirm that the chosen package includes the meal as well as the performance.
Check the return ride plan in advance, especially if attending on Saturday night.
decemberNotes: December is a busy Chiang Mai travel month. The regular Tue–Sun schedule and 18:30–20:30 hours are published by the venue, but no date-specific December 2026 calendar was found; reconfirm before making plans. Allow extra road time around Saturday Walking Street.
uncertainties: The venue has not published a date-specific December 2026 schedule, ticket price or package availability in the sources checked.
Accessibility details, chair seating, dietary accommodation and transport inclusions need direct confirmation.
The third-party from-price may not match the package or price offered for the selected date.
